```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(pacman)
p_load(brms, tidyverse, here, tidybayes, ggdist, HDInterval, ape)
set.seed(12412)
```

```{r}

# one marker, load and keep only mapped entries (tip_name present)
m <- "permanent_scarring"
d <- read_csv(here("data","model","external","input", paste0(m,".csv")),
              show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(y = as.integer(.data[[m]]),
         world_region = fct_relevel(factor(world_region), "Africa"))

d_phylo <- d |> filter(!is.na(tip_name))
cat("baseline N:", nrow(d), " | phylo N (mapped):", nrow(d_phylo), "\n")
cat("distinct tips in this marker:", n_distinct(d_phylo$tip_name), "\n")

# prune the tree to the tips we use
tree <- read.tree(here("data","jaeger2018","world.tre"))
tips <- unique(d_phylo$tip_name)
cat("tips in data:", length(tips),
    " | of which in tree:", sum(tips %in% tree$tip.label), "\n")   # MUST be all

tree_pruned <- keep.tip(tree, tips)

# THE key checks on the tree before building A
cat("\n--- tree diagnostics ---\n")
cat("is.ultrametric:", is.ultrametric(tree_pruned), "\n")
cat("is.rooted     :", is.rooted(tree_pruned), "\n")
cat("has branch lengths:", !is.null(tree_pruned$edge.length), "\n")
cat("root-to-tip distance range:",
    round(range(diag(vcv.phylo(tree_pruned))), 3), "\n")  # equal => ultrametric

```

```{r}
A <- vcv.phylo(tree_pruned, corr = TRUE)

# 1. For each tip, its MEAN correlation with all others.
#    A tip that's anomalously isolated (near-0 with everything) shows up here.
mean_cor <- (rowSums(A) - 1) / (ncol(A) - 1)   # subtract self (=1)
sort(mean_cor)[1:15]                            # the 15 MOST isolated tips

# 2. Are the ancient tips among the isolated ones?
ancient <- c("ST.CHINESE.OLD_CHINESE","IE.GREEK.GREEK_ANCIENT",
             "AA.SEMITIC.CLASSICAL_SYRIAC","AA.SEMITIC.AKKADIAN",
             "AA.SEMITIC.BIBLICAL_HEBREW")  # adjust to your actual tips
mean_cor[names(mean_cor) %in% ancient]
```
```{r}
# --- build A with names matching tip_name exactly (brms matches by name) ---
A <- vcv.phylo(tree_pruned, corr = TRUE)
stopifnot(all(d_phylo$tip_name %in% rownames(A)))   # every entry's tip is in A

d_phylo <- d_phylo |>
  mutate(phylo = tip_name)     # identical values, different column name

f_phylo <- bf(
  permanent_scarring ~ 1 + violent_external + year_scaled +
    (1 | world_region) +
    (1 | gr(phylo, cov = A)) +   # phylogenetic: keyed on `phylo`, structured by A
    (1 | tip_name)               # non-phylogenetic: keyed on `tip_name`
)

priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = Intercept),
  prior(normal(0, 1),   class = b),
  prior(exponential(1), class = sd)   # applies to ALL three sd terms
)



fit_phylo <- brm(
  formula = f_phylo,
  data    = d_phylo,
  data2   = list(A = A),               # <-- A passed here, by name
  family  = bernoulli("logit"),
  prior   = priors,
  chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000, cores = 4,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 12),
  seed = 1342, backend = "cmdstanr", silent = 2
)
```

```{r}

# 1. convergence + divergences FIRST
cat("divergences:", sum(subset(nuts_params(fit_phylo), Parameter=="divergent__")$Value), "\n")
cat("max Rhat   :", round(max(rhat(fit_phylo), na.rm=TRUE), 4), "\n")

# 2. THE key check: do the two tip variances separate?
summary(fit_phylo)$random    # look at sd(Intercept) for BOTH tip_name terms + world_region

# 3. are the two tip SDs trading off? (posterior correlation between them)
vc <- as_draws_df(fit_phylo) |>
  select(matches("^sd_.*Intercept")) |>          # the three sd parameters
  set_names(c("sd_region","sd_phylo","sd_tip"))  # adjust order after seeing names
cat("\nposterior cor(sd_phylo, sd_tip):",
    round(cor(vc$sd_phylo, vc$sd_tip), 2), "\n")  # strongly negative = trading off

```

```{r}
summary(fit_phylo)
```
